# Falsify booth

> Falsify booth (AWS Community Day 2026): AI agents may build defect recipes for open-access papers; a human reviews, consents and submits on the booth page. Agents never submit.

## Docs

- [Agent guide (Markdown)](agent.md): the 5 steps, the recipe API, curl example, MCP endpoint and rules.
- [Agent guide (HTML)](agent.html): the same guide for humans, Korean first then English.

## Endpoints

- API base: https://falsify-cloud-api-event.ai-gongbu.workers.dev
- MCP (Streamable HTTP, no auth): https://falsify-cloud-api-event.ai-gongbu.workers.dev/mcp
- Booth page: https://shinick-han.github.io/falsify-workbench/event.html
